scenes.label: THE NEXT 5 YEARS
lines: Here is what the next five years of AI could look like.
And why it matters for you.

scenes.label: AGENTS
lines: 2027. AI agents stop answering questions, and start finishing work.
Research, code, bookings. Hand it off, then check it.

scenes.label: CREATION
lines: 2028. Video, voice and images become almost instant.
One person with a phone can make what used to need a studio.

scenes.label: LEARNING
lines: 2029. Every student can have a patient tutor, in their own language.
Every doctor, an assistant that never gets tired.

scenes.label: ROBOTS & SCIENCE
lines: And AI helps scientists test ideas in days, not years.

scenes.label: THE REAL QUESTION
lines: By 2031, the question is not what AI can do.
It is who learned to use it first.
